headline.text: L1 sanitation findings repeat — swecos dirty again, *pallets left outside* creating pest risk, pest control device damaged.

summary: Three recurring sanitation gaps at L1 flagged today: swecos found dirty again on S1, night shift leaving pallets outside creating pest harborage (repeat issue), and pest control device 72 damaged awaiting replacement. One hold under investigation — L1 S1 cooling tunnel moisture reported but not confirmed on inspection.

holds.title: S1 cooling tunnel moisture investigation
holds.summary: Moisture in cooling tunnel 1 triggered hold inquiry; day shift inspected line twice (morning and 09:15) and found no moisture or signs of moisture.
holds.status: Investigation complete — no moisture found on repeated inspections; hold disposition pending FSQA confirmation.

quality.title: Truffle Line chocolate exposure
quality.summary: One piece per row showing chocolate exposure (ganache visible through coating); enrober operator making adjustments to coverage.

sanitation.title: S1 swecos found dirty again
sanitation.summary: Swecos (vibratory screens) found dirty at S1 line startup — recurring finding indicating cleaning verification gap.
sanitation.status: Open — line operator re-cleaned; root cause of recurring failure not addressed.

sanitation.title: Pest control device 72 damaged
sanitation.summary: Pest control monitoring device 72 is damaged and needs replacement; maintenance and pest control vendor notified.

sanitation.title: Pallets placed outside creating pest harborage
sanitation.summary: Night shift garbage crew repeatedly leaving pallets outside warehouse, creating risk of bugs, rodents, feces exposure to warehouse and returned pallets — recurring issue despite previous coaching.
sanitation.status: Open — plant manager escalation requested for recurring noncompliance.

opportunities.text: Consider adding sweco cleanliness to S1 pre-op checklist with photo documentation — today's 'found dirty again' message suggests cleaning verification is not catching failures before startup.
Review waste handling training and supervision for night shift sanitation crew — pallets left outside creating pest risk is a repeat escalation from warehouse despite previous coaching.
